tvShow.name: Star Detective Precure!
tvShow.overview: On her 14th birthday, Anna Akechi meets a magical fairy and suddenly time-slips from 2027 to 1999! There, she befriends Mikuru, a spirited girl who dreams of becoming a detective. When mysterious thefts stir rumors of the Phantom Thieves, the two transform into Detective Precure, using courage, deduction, and friendship to solve cases and uncover the secret of Anna's journey through time.

episodes.name: Debut! Star Detective Precure!
episodes.overview: On Anna Akechi’s 14th birthday, she puts on a pendant and meets a fairy named Pochitan.

episodes.name: Introducing the Genius, Jett-Senpai!
episodes.overview: Mikuru takes Anna to the CUREtto Detective Agency.

episodes.name: Everyone Come to the CUREtto Detective Agency!
episodes.overview: As black petals flutter and anxiety spreads throughout town, Uta proposes holding a concert and inviting a "special guest."

episodes.name: Exciting! Our First Client!
episodes.overview: The CUREtto Detective Agency gets its first client.

episodes.name: Star Detectives In Trouble?
episodes.overview: Anna goes to Makoto Mirai Academy, Mikuru’s school, to give Mikuru an umbrella, but then she meets a troubled woman named Mariko who is looking for her little sister Keiko. Meanwhile, Mikuru is asked by the school’s Chairwoman to solve a case involving a ghost in the high school.

episodes.name: Miraculous Pre-Kit Mirror Loupe!
episodes.overview: Mikuru leaves the care of exhausted Pochitan to Anna and Jett-senpai.

episodes.name: Yikes! The School Is a Maze?
episodes.overview: Anna transfers to Mikuru's class at Makoto Mirai Academy. While surprised at the size of the campus, she and Mikuru find themselves lost in a puzzle maze created by Goemon.

episodes.name: Pretty Smiles at Pretty Holic!
episodes.overview: Anna and Mikuru convince Jett-senpai to make merchandise from his Pre-Kit inventions and open a store.

episodes.name: Don't Make Assumptions!
episodes.overview: A very popular actress, Shiruku Ieiri, comes to Makoto Mirai Academy to film a TV program which has her joining in on a play as a member of the drama club. But right before the performance a very special costume goes missing from the club office.

episodes.name: Solve the Mystery of the Painting!
episodes.overview: A client comes to the CUREtto Detective Agency, asking them to help solve a mystery.

crew.name: Noel Año-Nuevo
crew.original_name: ノエル・アンニョヌエボ

episodes.name: Cure Arcana Shadow Appears!
episodes.overview: A calling card from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild is sent to the Hosho Art Museum. Anna and Mikuru arrive on the scene, there Luluka strikes a conversation with Anna while in the Starlight Princess display room.

episodes.name: The Secret of Cure Arcana Shadow
episodes.overview: Anna and Mikuru set out on a fact-finding mission to learn more about Cure Arcana Shadow.

episodes.name: Star Detectives VS Thieves
episodes.overview: Anna and the gang chase after Nijee, who has stolen a toy robot. As they face off against the Hanninda, Luluka comes with a message: Maestro Usonoir is on the move.

episodes.name: Pochitan's First Outing!
episodes.overview: Anna and Mikuru are on their way to school when Rei, the Student Council President...

episodes.name: The Secret of Luluka Moria
episodes.overview: In the letter that arrived from London, Anna and the others learn that Cure Arcana Shadow is a genius detective named Luluka Moria. They go to a lake in search of more clues, where they encounter Luluka herself.

episodes.name: Detective Ellie's Case Book?
episodes.overview: Novelist Eliza comes to the CUREtto Detective Agency to ask to work as a detective to get ideas for her next novel. Not long after that, the girls get a request to search for a missing cat.

episodes.name: Memories with Mom
episodes.overview: Anna sees the mother of a client and thinks about her own mother.

episodes.name: Star Detectives Assemble
episodes.overview: While they help set up an exhibition at Hosho Art Museum, a glass slipper on display goes missing. Anna and Mikuru look for clues, certain that it was the work of the Phantom Thieves’ Guild.

episodes.name: Invitation to the Labyrinth Train?!
episodes.overview: Anna and Mikuru are on a school trip, but Goemon appears.

episodes.name: Legend from a Certain Island!
episodes.overview: A desperate letter arrives at the CUREtto Detective Agency: "The island could disappear!" Leading Anna and Mikuru to take a boat to the isolated island. To solve the case, they must unravel the secret behind an old island song.

episodes.name: Detective Ellie's Case Book, Part 2?
episodes.overview: Eriza Kurusu appears before Anna and Mikuru and tells them, "I want to join the CUREtto Detective Agency!"

episodes.name: Shiruka's Resolve
episodes.overview: Shiruku Ieiri invites Anna and Mikuru to her show, and when they come to her dressing room, she shows them a calling card that was left by the Phantom Thieves’ Guild. As they search the theater before the performance, Anna spots Luluka.

episodes.name: Kurea, Sleuthing, and Ice Cream
episodes.overview: Prompted by a prediction in the Tome of Mirages, Luluka goes to Patisserie ChuChu to steal a Makoto Jewel embedded in a photograph. When Kurea brings her some ice cream, Luluka hands her a calling card…

episodes.name: Case Closed with Rei!
episodes.overview: Together with Rei, Anna and Mikuru investigate some mysterious incidents happening at Makoto Mirai Academy. As they check the science room, music room, and art room, Rei notices a pattern.

crew.name: Noel Año-Nuevo
crew.original_name: ノエル・アンニョヌエボ

episodes.name: Cure Eclair's Identity
episodes.overview: The perfume Jett-senpai has been making is finally ready. Then, a new calling card arrives from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild. Cure Eclair’s identity will finally be revealed!

episodes.name: Cure Eclair Returns!
episodes.overview: Kurea’s memory has been restored by the Top of Lily fragrance. Shushutan also reveals herself in front of everyone. Meanwhile, Usonoir, who has misused the power of the Makoto Jewel, loses control and goes on a rampage.

episodes.name: I'm a Star Detective Now!
episodes.overview: With her memory restored, Kurea confesses to Anna and Mikuru that she was never a detective. As they reel from this news, the owner of a restaurant enters with a request for them to search for her missing cook.

episodes.name: The Mysterious Thief Decchi Agein!
episodes.overview: Paul, an exchange student from London, receives a calling card from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild and runs to the CUREtto Detective Agency for help. The calling card looks very flashy, and the listed time is down to the second, making it different from previous cards.

episodes.name: The Duo's Past
episodes.overview: Decchi Agein and Goemon replay Kurea's world of memories. There, Anna and the gang witness Kurea and Luluka's first meeting at the London CUREtto Detective Agency three years earlier.

episodes.name: Eclipse Shadow
episodes.overview: During the summer holidays, Anna and the others go to Makoto Mirai Academy to help student council president Rei care for the flower beds. While working, they realize that the zinnias that were blooming just minutes earlier have all been cut.

episodes.name: Star Detective Cure Arcana
episodes.overview: Cure Answer and the others have their transformations dissolved by the sheer power of Eclipse Shadow. As Cure Eclair’s secrets and Luluka’s true intentions are revealed, Anna and Mikuru transform into Precures again and extend their hands to Kurea.

credits.name: Nao Toyama
credits.character: Luluka Moria / Cure Arcana Shadow / Cure Arcana (voice)
